function: DRL optimizes task offloading in RIS-aided cell-free cloud-edge IoT network
note: The learned part is DRL for task offloading, while the joint RIS and BS beamforming is solved by alternating optimization without learning.

function: Transformer-based recurrent networks classify modulation types in IRS-assisted IoT links
note: The learned method performs automatic modulation classification, a function outside the seven areas, even though the link is IRS-assisted.

function: Alternating optimization of UAV trajectory, bandwidth, power and computing for FL latency
note: The method is alternating optimization with no learned component, and federated learning without over-the-air aggregation is only the application that the UAV link serves.

function: Broad learning server allocation and Q-learning multihop path selection in MEC networks
note: Learning is applied to edge server allocation and multihop routing, while the transmit power control uses a consensus mechanism rather than learning.

function: Hierarchical DRL controls ground jammer beamwidth and UAV jammer movement and power
note: The learned method performs offensive jamming that minimizes the SJNR of malicious UAVs, which serves no communication link and is outside the seven areas.

function: Multi-agent hybrid-action DRL for task offloading and MEC resource allocation in SAGIN
note: The DRL learns task offloading and the allocation of resources in the MEC infrastructure to cut latency and energy, and the abstract states no learned power, bandwidth, or beam control of the satellite or UAV links.

function: Multi-agent RL learns operators' bidding strategies in auctions for leasing RISs
note: The learning is applied to the bidding of operators in a RIS leasing market, a network management decision, and not to the RIS phase shifts.

function: Subspace-based channel estimators and SIM phase optimization for multiuser holographic MIMO
note: The channel estimators are subspace-based and the SIM phase shifts are optimized for MSE without any learned component, the neural network analogy referring only to the SIM architecture.

function: Sparse Bayesian learning algorithms estimate the channel of fluid antenna systems
note: Sparse Bayesian learning is used here as an iterative Bayesian sparse-recovery algorithm run on each observation, not as a model trained on data or by interaction.

function: Sensing-aided low-complexity timing synchronization for UAV-assisted OFDM using echo signals
note: The proposed synchronization method is an iterative threshold-based algorithm, and machine learning appears only among the baselines.

function: Overview of NeRF and 3D Gaussian splatting training and rendering in 6G
note: The paper is a comprehensive overview of radiance field rendering in 6G networks, with only an illustrative semantic communication case study.

function: Survey of large language models for integrated satellite-aerial-terrestrial networks
note: The paper reviews the potential, challenges, and future directions of large language models in ISATNs rather than proposing and evaluating a method.

function: Survey of optimization and performance analysis in coexisting satellite-terrestrial networks
note: The paper surveys optimization frameworks and performance analysis for coexisting satellite and terrestrial networks rather than proposing a method.

function: PPO-based DRL allocates URLLC traffic in RIS-assisted hybrid eMBB-URLLC network slicing
note: The DRL performs URLLC scheduling within network slicing, while the RIS phase shifts and eMBB power are obtained by alternating optimization without learning.

function: SVM, KNN and boosted trees classify vehicular events from CW Doppler spectrograms
note: The learned models classify vehicular events from continuous-wave radio sensing, a sensing-only task in a system that does not communicate, with ISAC mentioned only as future use.

function: Survey of generative AI applications in physical-layer communications
note: The paper is a survey of generative AI for physical-layer communications, as its title and abstract state.

function: Secrecy outage analysis and DNN-based prediction for UAV-aided RIS NOMA
note: The deep neural network only predicts the secrecy outage probability, a performance-evaluation task outside the seven areas, while the system itself is analyzed in closed form.

function: Meta-transfer learning network recognizes unseen modulation types from few labeled samples
note: The learned method performs automatic modulation recognition, which is outside the seven areas.

function: TD3-based agentic AI plans UAV trajectory and fair computation offloading scheduling
note: The DRL learns UAV trajectory, obstacle avoidance, and fairness-aware offloading scheduling, all above the physical layer, with no learned power, bandwidth, or beam control.

function: Precoding-driven channel estimation and data detection with MMSE precoding for FTN
note: The frame design, channel estimation, MMSE precoding, and detection are model-based algorithms with no learned component.

function: Trellis shaping with convolutional codes reduces sidelobes of OFDM ISAC waveforms
note: The waveform shaping relies on convolutional codes and Viterbi decoding, which are not learning.

function: Online SCA minimizes federated learning training time in collocated massive MIMO SWIPT
note: Beamforming, data rates, and local update frequency are optimized by successive convex approximation without learning, and federated learning without over-the-air computation is only the application served.

function: Delay-aware DDQN learns computation offloading decisions in LEO satellite-terrestrial networks
note: The DRL makes computation offloading decisions and the computing allocation uses a multi-level feedback queue, so the learning is above the physical layer.

function: Mean-field hybrid PPO learns UAV trajectories and ground-sensor data-collection scheduling
note: The learned decisions are UAV trajectories and the scheduling of ground sensors to minimize age of information, with no learned transmit power, bandwidth, or beam control.

function: DRL plans UAV flight paths and recharging schedules in UAV-UGV urban monitoring
note: DRL learns only UAV flight paths and recharging schedules, while the RIS configuration uses differential evolution and the UGV routes a genetic algorithm, neither of them learned.

function: Mixture-of-experts networks detect pilot spoofing and localize eavesdropper to select jamming BS
note: The learned parts are attack detection and eavesdropper localization, which are excluded functions, but the localizer selects the jamming base station of a secure multi-cell precoding scheme evaluated by secrecy rate, a boundary with area 3.
